approaches.title: Dynamic programming for minimum path sum
approaches.summary: Computes the minimum path sum using dynamic programming over the grid. Revision 1 updates the grid in place, while revision 2 keeps only one accumulated row using a fold.

revisions.shortChangeSummary: Uses in-place two-dimensional dynamic programming, accumulating minimum path sums directly in the input grid.
